nodes.label: promptflow:settings read at boot
nodes.rationale: Reads the theme preference (default system) from the promptflow:settings localStorage entry and resolves it against prefers-color-scheme.

nodes.label: Pre-paint theme bootstrap
nodes.rationale: Sets the theme on the html element before first paint so there is no dark/light flash; must be kept in step with src/lib/theme.ts. Falls back to dark on error.

nodes.label: Dev-only .env.local fallback key
nodes.rationale: Ignored in production builds because Vite inlines VITE_* values into the bundle.

nodes.label: Resizable nodes and themes
nodes.rationale: Every node resizes; text size set globally and per node; light and dark themes or follow system.

nodes.label: No backend
nodes.rationale: Requests go straight from the browser to the provider so the user key never touches a server; there is no server of ours.

nodes.label: Privacy
nodes.rationale: Flows, settings and run history stay in localStorage and nothing is uploaded; API key stored separately (this tab only by default) and sent only to its own provider.

nodes.label: HTML app shell
nodes.rationale: Empty div with id root; loads module script /src/main.tsx as the React entry point.

nodes.label: Favicon and theme-color meta
nodes.rationale: Title Prompt Flow, SVG favicon at /favicon.svg, theme-color #161310, viewport meta.

nodes.label: PromptFlow Brand Mark (two nodes joined by a flowing edge)
nodes.norm_label: promptflow brand mark (two nodes joined by a flowing edge)

nodes.label: Brand Palette (dark ink, violet accent, warm cream)
nodes.norm_label: brand palette (dark ink, violet accent, warm cream)

nodes.label: Phase-by-phase change mode
nodes.rationale: Work phase by phase as broken down in PLAN.md; stop after each phase and wait for feedback; show a short summary per phase.

nodes.label: Planning mode rules
nodes.rationale: Never assume design, stack or scope; ask clarifying questions up front in one batch; check PLAN.md first and flag conflicts explicitly.

nodes.label: PromptFlow project context
nodes.rationale: Node-based visual canvas for chaining LLM prompts (React Flow + OpenRouter); the full spec lives in PLAN.md and must be read before any task.

nodes.label: Graphify codebase navigation
nodes.rationale: Query the knowledge graph before grep or file reads for structure questions; treat graph answers as a map and verify in source; fall back to grep only for exact strings.

nodes.label: Graph refresh after changes
nodes.rationale: Run graphify update for code changes (AST only); run /graphify . --update after doc or image changes; commit graph files as a chore(graph) commit; never hand-edit graphify-out.

nodes.label: Functional components and hooks only
nodes.rationale: No class components.

nodes.label: One component per file
nodes.rationale: Colocate related types in the same file unless shared across modules, then place them in src/types/.

nodes.label: End-to-end tests
nodes.rationale: E2E tests use a fake model API so they need no key and cost nothing; they use an installed Chromium or E2E_CHROMIUM, otherwise npx playwright install chromium.

nodes.label: npm scripts table
nodes.rationale: dev, build (typecheck and build), typecheck (tsc -b --noEmit), lint (ESLint), test (Vitest), test:e2e (Playwright), format (Prettier).

nodes.label: Branch and merge
nodes.rationale: One node can feed many; a Merge node joins branches in canvas order, optionally with branch names.

nodes.label: Five node types
nodes.rationale: Input, Prompt (templates with {{input}}), Agent (any model), Merge (join branches), Output (rendered Markdown).

nodes.label: How a flow works
nodes.rationale: Independent branches run side by side and wait for each other at a Merge; selecting a node opens its settings.

nodes.label: Subagent rules
nodes.rationale: Define project subagents under .opencode/agent/ with mode subagent and explicit model; use them for scoped tasks, not open-ended feature builds.

nodes.label: Approved tech stack
nodes.rationale: TypeScript strict, React and Vite, @xyflow/react, Zustand, Tailwind, OpenRouter via OpenAI-compatible SDK. Do not introduce a different framework, state library or styling approach without asking first.

nodes.label: Tech stack
nodes.rationale: TypeScript strict, React 18, Vite, @xyflow/react, Zustand, Tailwind CSS, Zod, Vitest, Playwright.

nodes.label: Command palette
nodes.rationale: Ctrl or Cmd plus K opens an action list or jumps to a node by name.

nodes.label: PromptFlow overview
nodes.rationale: Visual, node-based playground for building multi-step prompt flows, with cost of every run visible.

nodes.label: Model tiers
nodes.rationale: Strongest model for planning, review and multi-step implementation; lightest model for routine tasks; default to the stronger model when unsure.

nodes.label: Concise response style
nodes.rationale: Keep responses concise unless detail is requested; no filler summaries, just do the work and report what changed.

nodes.label: Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Keyboard-operable dialogs and menus, status not relying on colour alone, reduced-motion support, axe-clean in both themes.

nodes.label: Undo, redo and Tidy layout
nodes.rationale: Undo/redo, copy/paste/duplicate, Tidy auto-layout, minimap, and an Undo toast when something replaces the canvas.

nodes.label: Live results and retry
nodes.rationale: Text streams into the Output node; failed steps show why and offer Retry that reruns only from that step.

nodes.label: src directory layout
nodes.rationale: components (canvas, nodes, panels, dialogs, palette, toolbar), engine (execution, scheduling, retries, cost estimates), lib (providers, serialization, layout, reports, variables), store (graph, run, settings, model catalog, history, saved flows), types; e2e for Playwright tests.

nodes.label: Six providers
nodes.rationale: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq and Mistral; one key at a time, provider detected from the key.

nodes.label: Markdown reports
nodes.rationale: Download any run as one Markdown report: result first, then every step with model, tokens and cost.

nodes.label: Saved flows
nodes.rationale: Flows autosave in the browser; can duplicate, rename, export and import as JSON, but the key is never exported.

nodes.label: Variables
nodes.rationale: Write {{topic}} anywhere and fill it from the Variables dialog to reuse one flow.
